title: Turn on the torch
aliases: how do i turn on the torch
help me see in the dark

steps.instruction: Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen.
Tap the torch icon if the light is off.
Swipe up from the bottom edge to close the controls. The light stays on.

source_note: Control Centre on Face ID iPhones with iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Assumes the torch control is present on the first page; controls can be moved or removed. Home button iPhones use an upward swipe to open Control Centre and the Home button to close it. Some regions call the torch Flashlight. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-au/guide/iphone/iphf574afb44/26/ios/26
